description.text: Chemical engineering and Technology is an engineering discipline that studies the common laws of material transformation, energy transfer and material separation in process industries represented by the chemical industry, and applies them to product development, process optimization and equipment design. Its core lies in transforming chemical principles into industrial production through "unit operations" (such as distillation, reaction, filtration, etc.), solving key technical problems from small-scale laboratory trials to large-scale industrial production. It serves as a bridge discipline connecting fields such as chemistry, materials, energy, and the environment.

duration.text: The Chemical engineering and technology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3. Not other scholarship recipients
